narrativePost.fullText:
# LinkedIn Technical Marketing Post: Internal IT & Ops Request Router

Deterministic ticket categorization router that ingests chaotic Slack/email messages, classifies urgency and department (IT, Legal, HR, Finance), and assigns SLAs.

### The Problem
Most companies lose thousands in hidden operational waste every single month.

### The Engineered Fix
We engineered a zero-dependency system to solve this.

👉 Try the live interactive simulator here:
https://gideonbawa-website.netlify.app/simulators/internal-request-router/

#SoftwareEngineering #Automation #SystemsArchitecture #BuildInPublic
